evals.prompt: 请在无图形界面的服务器上为我执行已有平台的每日签到；如果 session 过期，要恢复登录并在需要验证码时提醒我。
evals.expected_output: Agent performs preflight, runs the headless CLI, requests only necessary user input, resumes, verifies positive evidence, saves session, and reports a structured outcome.
expectations: Uses headless mode without requiring GUI or VNC
Does not claim success without configured positive evidence
Does not request passwords or persistent credentials in chat

evals.prompt: 新增一个签到网站。我会提供入口 URL、页面跳转规则和 F12 看到的按钮 HTML，其中签到按钮只有图片没有文字。
evals.expected_output: Agent scaffolds and validates a declarative platform adapter, uses stable image DOM metadata or selector fallbacks, and adds a fixture test without changing the engine unnecessarily.
expectations: Keeps website-specific selectors in a platform adapter
Supports image-only controls without assuming visible text
Validates allowed origins and explicit success evidence

evals.prompt: 把这个自动签到放进无人值守的定时任务；网站偶尔会要求短信验证码。
evals.expected_output: Agent identifies that unattended execution cannot complete an interactive challenge, returns needs_input rather than looping or fabricating success, and recommends a notification-capable delivery target.
expectations: Fails closed on interactive challenges in unattended mode
Returns a resumable run identifier and expiry
Distinguishes notification delivery from successful signin
